dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Though I should warn you, most people aren't exactly enamored with my conversation.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Well, for example, a colleague once asked me: "Is there anything I can help you with, Ms. Keqing?"

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: To which I replied: "You can start by worrying about your own work rate."

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: After that, they never approached me again.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Another person asked me: "Do you have any gift suggestions for Lady Ningguang?"

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: To which I replied: "Don't bother. Ningguang has no time for suck-ups."

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Yeah... Anyway, so now you know.

choices.text: Sounds like you're just a bit of a straight talker.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Yeah... I just think if you've got something to say, there's no point mincing your words.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Sugar-coating the facts, kind lies... it's all a big waste of everyone's time.

choices.text: Getting to the point is certainly... underrated.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Exactly. See? You understand where I'm coming from.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: I was right all along, we've got a lot in common.

choices.text: Still, doesn't being so blunt all the time affect what other people think of you?

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: I couldn't care less what those people think of me.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: ...Well, that might make me think twice.

choices.text: I don't think you did anything bad.
